title: Trial and Error (TV series)
executive_producers: Donald L. SeigelJerry PerzigianHoward BrownTommy Chong
premise_summary: Trial and Error is an American sitcom that was broadcast on CBS from March 15 to March 29, 1988. It was canceled after the third episode, leaving the remaining five episodes unaired.
